extracted.name: Campbell's Slow Cooker Savory Pot Roast
extracted.description: This tender pot roast recipe is braised to perfection in a mixture of Campbell's Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup, onion soup mix, carrots, and potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup (Regular, 98% Fat Free or Healthy Request)
1 (2 ounce) pouch Campbell's® Dry Onion Soup and Recipe Mix
1 (3 pound) boneless beef bottom round roast or chuck pot roast
instruction_lines: Combine potatoes, carrots, mushroom soup, and onion soup mix in a 4 1/2-quart slow cooker. Add beef; toss to coat.
Cover slow cooker. Cook on Low until beef is fork-tender, 8 to 9 hours.
